/**
 * =============================================================================
 * Innoventix Platform — Invitation Service
 * =============================================================================
 * Handles organization invitation lifecycle, seat limit enforcement,
 * RBAC authorization, cryptographic tokens, and multi-tenant audit trail.
 * =============================================================================
 */

import { queryOne, transaction } from '../db';
import { invitationRepo } from '../db/repositories/invitation-repo';
import { orgRepo } from '../db/repositories/org-repo';
import { userRepo } from '../db/repositories/user-repo';
import { getCurrentPlan } from '../billing/current-plan';
import { normalizeEmail, isValidEmail } from '../validation/email';
import { generateToken, hashToken } from '../security/invite-token';
import { logInvitationAudit } from '../audit/invitations';
import { canResend, canRevoke } from '../invitations/status';
import { sendEmail } from '../email/sender';
import { renderInviteEmail } from '../email/templates';
import { Invitation, InvitationRole } from '../types/database';

export interface InvitationSessionContext {
  userId?: string | null;
  orgId?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  user?: {
    id: string;
    email?: string;
  } | null;
  role?: string | null;
}

export interface CreateInvitationInput {
  email: string;
  role: InvitationRole;
}

export interface CreateInvitationSuccess {
  success: true;
  invitation: Invitation;
  rawToken?: string;
  alreadyPending?: boolean;
  sendFailed?: boolean;
  warning?: string;
}

export interface CreateInvitationError {
  success: false;
  error: 'unauthorized' | 'forbidden' | 'invalid_email' | 'already_member' | 'LIMIT_REACHED';
  message: string;
  status: number;
  planName?: string;
  limit?: number;
  current?: number;
}

export type CreateInvitationResult = CreateInvitationSuccess | CreateInvitationError;

/**
 * Creates a new organization invitation enforcing the 10 sequential domain rules:
 * 1. Require authenticated session.
 * 2. Only owner or admin may invite.
 * 3. Admin cannot invite another admin or owner. Only owner can invite admin.
 * 4. Normalize and validate the email address.
 * 5. Reject if email belongs to an existing member.
 * 6. Return existing record with alreadyPending=true if invite is already pending.
 * 7. Enforce plan maxMembers seat quota.
 * 8. Enforce plan maxPendingInvites quota.
 * 9. Cryptographically generate token, hash, store, and record audit event.
 * 10. Attempt transactional email dispatch; retain row and warn if delivery fails.
 */
export async function createInvitation(
  session: InvitationSessionContext | null | undefined,
  input: CreateInvitationInput
): Promise<CreateInvitationResult> {
  // 1. Require an authenticated session
  const actorUserId = session?.userId || session?.user?.id;
  const orgId = session?.orgId;

  if (!session || !actorUserId || !orgId) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'unauthorized',
      status: 401,
      message: 'Authentication and active organization context required',
    };
  }

  // 2. Only owner or admin may invite. Member and viewer get forbidden.
  const actorRole = await orgRepo.getMemberRole(orgId, actorUserId);
  if (!actorRole || (actorRole !== 'owner' && actorRole !== 'admin')) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'forbidden',
      status: 403,
      message: 'Forbidden: Only organization owners and admins can send invitations',
    };
  }

  // 3. Admin cannot invite another admin or owner. Only owner can invite admin.
  if (actorRole === 'admin' && (input.role === 'admin' || (input.role as string) === 'owner')) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'forbidden',
      status: 403,
      message: 'Forbidden: Admins cannot invite other admins or owners. Only owners can invite admins.',
    };
  }

  // 4. Normalize and validate the email (Prompt 16)
  const normalizedEmail = normalizeEmail(input.email);
  if (!isValidEmail(normalizedEmail)) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_email',
      status: 400,
      message: 'Invalid email address provided',
    };
  }

  // 5. Check if the email already belongs to a member of this organization
  const existingMember = await queryOne<{ id: string }>(
    `SELECT m.id 
     FROM organization_members m
     JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.id
     WHERE m.organization_id = $1 
       AND lower(trim(u.email)) = $2`,
    [orgId, normalizedEmail]
  );

  if (existingMember) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'already_member',
      status: 409,
      message: 'This email already belongs to a member of this organization',
    };
  }

  // 6. If a pending invite exists for this email, return it with alreadyPending flag
  const existingPending = await invitationRepo.findPendingByEmail(orgId, normalizedEmail);
  if (existingPending) {
    return {
      success: true,
      invitation: existingPending,
      alreadyPending: true,
    };
  }

  // Retrieve current subscription plan & seat rules
  const planInfo = await getCurrentPlan(orgId);
  const planConfig = planInfo.planConfig;

  // 7. Check maxPendingInvites
  const pendingCount = await invitationRepo.countPending(orgId);
  if (pendingCount >= planConfig.maxPendingInvites) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'LIMIT_REACHED',
      status: 403,
      message: `Pending invitations limit reached for ${planConfig.name} plan (${planConfig.maxPendingInvites} pending)`,
      planName: planConfig.name,
      limit: planConfig.maxPendingInvites,
      current: pendingCount,
    };
  }

  // 8. Check seats: countSeatsUsed + 1 must not exceed the plan's maxMembers
  const seatsUsed = await orgRepo.countSeatsUsed(orgId);
  if (seatsUsed + 1 > planConfig.maxMembers) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'LIMIT_REACHED',
      status: 403,
      message: `Seat limit reached for ${planConfig.name} plan (${planConfig.maxMembers} seats)`,
      planName: planConfig.name,
      limit: planConfig.maxMembers,
      current: seatsUsed,
    };
  }

  // 9. Generate token, store hash, expires_at now plus 7 days, write audit event
  const rawToken = generateToken();
  const tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 7 days

  const invitation = await invitationRepo.insertInvitation(orgId, {
    email: normalizedEmail,
    role: input.role,
    tokenHash,
    invitedBy: actorUserId,
    expiresAt,
  });

  // Write immutable audit event
  await logInvitationAudit({
    action: 'invite.created',
    organizationId: orgId,
    actorId: actorUserId,
    targetEmail: normalizedEmail,
    role: input.role,
    details: {
      invitationId: invitation.id,
      role: input.role,
      expiresAt: invitation.expires_at,
    },
  });

  // 10. Send the email. If sending fails, retain the invite row with send_failed flag
  let sendWarning: string | undefined;
  let sendFailed = false;

  try {
    const org = await orgRepo.findById(orgId);
    const inviter = await userRepo.findById(actorUserId);
    const emailTemplate = renderInviteEmail({
      inviterName: (inviter as any)?.full_name || (inviter as any)?.name || 'A team member',
      organizationName: org?.name || 'Your organization',
      role: input.role,
      rawToken,
      expiresAt,
      inviterEmail: inviter?.email,
      inviterEmailVerified: (inviter as any)?.email_verified ?? false,
    });

    const sendRes = await sendEmail({
      to: normalizedEmail,
      subject: emailTemplate.subject,
      html: emailTemplate.html,
      text: emailTemplate.text,
      displayName: emailTemplate.displayName,
      replyTo: emailTemplate.replyTo,
    });

    if (!sendRes.success) {
      throw new Error(sendRes.error || 'Failed to dispatch email');
    }
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.warn(`[INVITATION_EMAIL_FAILED] Failed to send email to ${normalizedEmail}:`, error);
    sendFailed = true;
    sendWarning = 'Invitation created, but notification email could not be delivered.';
    await invitationRepo.markSendFailed(orgId, invitation.id, true);
    invitation.send_failed = true;
    await logInvitationAudit({
      action: 'invite.send_failed',
      organizationId: orgId,
      actorId: actorUserId,
      targetEmail: normalizedEmail,
      role: input.role,
      details: {
        invitationId: invitation.id,
        error: error?.message || String(error),
      },
    });
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    invitation,
    rawToken,
    sendFailed,
    warning: sendWarning,
  };
}

export interface ResendInvitationSuccess {
  success: true;
  invitation: Invitation;
  rawToken: string;
  sendFailed?: boolean;
  warning?: string;
}

export interface ResendInvitationError {
  success: false;
  error: 'unauthorized' | 'forbidden' | 'not_found' | 'invalid_status';
  status: number;
  message: string;
}

export type ResendInvitationResult = ResendInvitationSuccess | ResendInvitationError;

/**
 * Resends an existing invitation:
 * - Requires owner or admin permissions.
 * - Enforces allowed states from Prompt 07 (pending or expired).
 * - Replaces old token hash so previous invitation links immediately stop working.
 * - Resets expiry to 7 days from now.
 * - Writes invite.resent audit event.
 */
export async function resendInvitation(
  session: InvitationSessionContext | null | undefined,
  inviteId: string
): Promise<ResendInvitationResult> {
  const actorUserId = session?.userId || session?.user?.id;
  const orgId = session?.orgId;

  if (!session || !actorUserId || !orgId) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'unauthorized',
      status: 401,
      message: 'Authentication and active organization context required',
    };
  }

  const actorRole = await orgRepo.getMemberRole(orgId, actorUserId);
  if (!actorRole || (actorRole !== 'owner' && actorRole !== 'admin')) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'forbidden',
      status: 403,
      message: 'Forbidden: Only organization owners and admins can resend invitations',
    };
  }

  const invite = await invitationRepo.findById(orgId, inviteId);
  if (!invite) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'not_found',
      status: 404,
      message: 'Invitation not found in this organization',
    };
  }

  if (!canResend(invite)) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_status',
      status: 400,
      message: `Cannot resend invitation with status ${invite.status}`,
    };
  }

  const rawToken = generateToken();
  const tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const updated = await invitationRepo.updateTokenAndExpiry(orgId, inviteId, tokenHash, expiresAt);
  if (!updated) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'not_found',
      status: 404,
      message: 'Invitation not found in this organization',
    };
  }

  // Audit event
  await logInvitationAudit({
    action: 'invite.resent',
    organizationId: orgId,
    actorId: actorUserId,
    targetEmail: updated.email,
    role: updated.role,
    details: {
      invitationId: updated.id,
      expiresAt: updated.expires_at,
    },
  });

  let sendFailed = false;
  let sendWarning: string | undefined;

  try {
    const org = await orgRepo.findById(orgId);
    const inviter = await userRepo.findById(actorUserId);
    const emailTemplate = renderInviteEmail({
      inviterName: (inviter as any)?.full_name || (inviter as any)?.name || 'A team member',
      organizationName: org?.name || 'Your organization',
      role: updated.role,
      rawToken,
      expiresAt,
      inviterEmail: inviter?.email,
      inviterEmailVerified: (inviter as any)?.email_verified ?? false,
    });

    const sendRes = await sendEmail({
      to: updated.email,
      subject: emailTemplate.subject,
      html: emailTemplate.html,
      text: emailTemplate.text,
      displayName: emailTemplate.displayName,
      replyTo: emailTemplate.replyTo,
    });

    if (!sendRes.success) {
      throw new Error(sendRes.error || 'Failed to dispatch email');
    }
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.warn(`[INVITATION_RESEND_FAILED] Failed to resend email to ${updated.email}:`, error);
    sendFailed = true;
    sendWarning = 'Invitation refreshed, but notification email could not be delivered.';
    await invitationRepo.markSendFailed(orgId, updated.id, true);
    updated.send_failed = true;
    await logInvitationAudit({
      action: 'invite.send_failed',
      organizationId: orgId,
      actorId: actorUserId,
      targetEmail: updated.email,
      role: updated.role,
      details: {
        invitationId: updated.id,
        error: error?.message || String(error),
      },
    });
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    invitation: updated,
    rawToken,
    sendFailed,
    warning: sendWarning,
  };
}

export interface RevokeInvitationSuccess {
  success: true;
  invitation: Invitation;
}

export interface RevokeInvitationError {
  success: false;
  error: 'unauthorized' | 'forbidden' | 'not_found' | 'invalid_status';
  status: number;
  message: string;
}

export type RevokeInvitationResult = RevokeInvitationSuccess | RevokeInvitationError;

/**
 * Revokes a pending invitation:
 * - Requires owner or admin permissions.
 * - Only pending invitations may be revoked.
 * - Sets status=revoked and revoked_at=now so the link stops working immediately.
 * - Writes invite.revoked audit event.
 */
export async function revokeInvitation(
  session: InvitationSessionContext | null | undefined,
  inviteId: string
): Promise<RevokeInvitationResult> {
  const actorUserId = session?.userId || session?.user?.id;
  const orgId = session?.orgId;

  if (!session || !actorUserId || !orgId) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'unauthorized',
      status: 401,
      message: 'Authentication and active organization context required',
    };
  }

  const actorRole = await orgRepo.getMemberRole(orgId, actorUserId);
  if (!actorRole || (actorRole !== 'owner' && actorRole !== 'admin')) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'forbidden',
      status: 403,
      message: 'Forbidden: Only organization owners and admins can revoke invitations',
    };
  }

  const invite = await invitationRepo.findById(orgId, inviteId);
  if (!invite) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'not_found',
      status: 404,
      message: 'Invitation not found in this organization',
    };
  }

  if (!canRevoke(invite)) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_status',
      status: 400,
      message: `Only pending invitations can be revoked. Current status is ${invite.status}.`,
    };
  }

  const updated = await invitationRepo.updateStatus(orgId, inviteId, {
    status: 'revoked',
    revokedAt: new Date(),
  });

  if (!updated) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'not_found',
      status: 404,
      message: 'Invitation not found in this organization',
    };
  }

  // Audit event
  await logInvitationAudit({
    action: 'invite.revoked',
    organizationId: orgId,
    actorId: actorUserId,
    targetEmail: updated.email,
    role: updated.role,
    details: {
      invitationId: updated.id,
      revokedAt: updated.revoked_at,
    },
  });

  return {
    success: true,
    invitation: updated,
  };
}

export interface AcceptInvitationSuccess {
  success: true;
  invitation: Invitation;
  organizationId: string;
  role: string;
}

export interface AcceptInvitationNeedsAccount {
  success: false;
  error: 'needs_account';
  needsAccount: true;
  status: 401;
  email: string;
  organizationId: string;
  role: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface AcceptInvitationWrongAccount {
  success: false;
  error: 'wrong_account';
  status: 403;
  expectedEmail: string;
  currentEmail: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface AcceptInvitationGeneralError {
  success: false;
  error: 'invalid_or_expired' | 'revoked' | 'already_accepted' | 'seat_limit_reached';
  status: number;
  message: string;
}

export type AcceptInvitationResult =
  | AcceptInvitationSuccess
  | AcceptInvitationNeedsAccount
  | AcceptInvitationWrongAccount
  | AcceptInvitationGeneralError;

/**
 * Accepts an invitation using a raw plaintext token:
 * 1. Hashes token and finds the invitation (unscoped). Invalid/not found returns invalid_or_expired.
 * 2. Checks status: revoked, already accepted, or expired returns matching error.
 * 3. If there is no session: returns needsAccount with invited email so UI locks email input.
 * 4. If session exists: enforces email matches the invitation email (case-insensitive); else wrongAccount.
 * 5. Adds the user to organization_members with the invited role and marks invitation accepted in one transaction.
 * 6. If already a member: marks invitation accepted and succeeds without duplicate errors.
 * 7. Writes invite.accepted audit log.
 */
export async function acceptInvitation(
  rawToken: string,
  session: InvitationSessionContext | null | undefined
): Promise<AcceptInvitationResult> {
  if (!rawToken || typeof rawToken !== 'string') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  const tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);
  const invite = await invitationRepo.findByTokenHash(tokenHash);

  // 1. Not found returns invalid_or_expired (same as expired so attackers cannot tell)
  if (!invite) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  // 2. Status checks
  if (invite.status === 'revoked' || invite.revoked_at) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'revoked',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation has been revoked',
    };
  }

  if (invite.status === 'accepted' || invite.accepted_at) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'already_accepted',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation has already been accepted',
    };
  }

  const now = new Date();
  if (new Date(invite.expires_at) <= now || invite.status === 'expired') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  // 3. If there is no session: return needsAccount
  const actorUserId = session?.userId || session?.user?.id;
  if (!session || !actorUserId) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'needs_account',
      needsAccount: true,
      status: 401,
      email: invite.email.toLowerCase(),
      organizationId: invite.organization_id,
      role: invite.role,
      message: 'Authentication required. Please sign up or log in with the invited email address.',
    };
  }

  // 4. If session exists: enforce email match
  let userEmail = session.email || session.user?.email;
  if (!userEmail) {
    const user = await userRepo.findById(actorUserId);
    userEmail = user?.email;
  }

  if (!userEmail || normalizeEmail(userEmail) !== normalizeEmail(invite.email)) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'wrong_account',
      status: 403,
      expectedEmail: invite.email.toLowerCase(),
      currentEmail: (userEmail || '').toLowerCase(),
      message: 'Logged in with the wrong account. Please switch to the account associated with this invitation.',
    };
  }

  // 5 & 6. Transaction: lock invitation, add member, mark accepted
  const txResult = await transaction(async (client) => {
    const lockedRes = await client.query<Invitation>(
      `SELECT * FROM invitations WHERE id = $1 AND organization_id = $2 FOR UPDATE`,
      [invite.id, invite.organization_id]
    );
    const locked = lockedRes.rows[0];
    if (!locked) {
      throw new Error('INVITATION_NOT_FOUND');
    }

    if (locked.status === 'accepted' || locked.accepted_at) {
      return { error: 'already_accepted' as const, invitation: locked };
    }
    if (locked.status === 'revoked' || locked.revoked_at) {
      return { error: 'revoked' as const, invitation: locked };
    }
    if (new Date(locked.expires_at) <= new Date()) {
      return { error: 'invalid_or_expired' as const, invitation: locked };
    }

    // Check if user is ALREADY a member
    const existingMemberRes = await client.query(
      `SELECT 1 FROM organization_members WHERE organization_id = $1 AND user_id = $2`,
      [locked.organization_id, actorUserId]
    );

    // If NOT already a member, check if organization seat limit is reached!
    if (existingMemberRes.rows.length === 0) {
      const planInfo = await getCurrentPlan(locked.organization_id);
      const planConfig = planInfo.planConfig;
      const memberCountRes = await client.query(
        `SELECT count(*) as count FROM organization_members WHERE organization_id = $1`,
        [locked.organization_id]
      );
      const currentMembers = parseInt(memberCountRes.rows[0].count, 10);
      if (currentMembers >= planConfig.maxMembers) {
        return {
          error: 'seat_limit_reached' as const,
          maxMembers: planConfig.maxMembers,
          planName: planConfig.name,
          invitation: locked,
        };
      }
    }

    // Insert into organization_members (idempotent with ON CONFLICT)
    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role, invited_by)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
       ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id) DO NOTHING`,
      [locked.organization_id, actorUserId, locked.role, locked.invited_by || null]
    );

    // Mark invitation accepted
    const updatedRes = await client.query<Invitation>(
      `UPDATE invitations
       SET 
         status = 'accepted',
         accepted_at = NOW(),
         accepted_by = $1,
         updated_at = NOW()
       WHERE id = $2 AND organization_id = $3
       RETURNING *`,
      [actorUserId, locked.id, locked.organization_id]
    );

    return { error: null, invitation: updatedRes.rows[0] };
  });

  if (txResult.error === 'seat_limit_reached') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'seat_limit_reached',
      status: 403,
      message: `This organization has reached its maximum seat limit (${txResult.maxMembers} members) for the ${txResult.planName} plan. Please contact an organization administrator or owner to upgrade the plan.`,
    };
  }
  if (txResult.error === 'already_accepted') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'already_accepted',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation has already been accepted',
    };
  }
  if (txResult.error === 'revoked') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'revoked',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation has been revoked',
    };
  }
  if (txResult.error === 'invalid_or_expired') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  // 7. Write invite.accepted audit log
  await logInvitationAudit({
    action: 'invite.accepted',
    organizationId: invite.organization_id,
    actorId: actorUserId,
    targetEmail: invite.email,
    role: invite.role,
    details: {
      invitationId: invite.id,
    },
  });

  return {
    success: true,
    invitation: txResult.invitation,
    organizationId: invite.organization_id,
    role: invite.role,
  };
}

export interface InvitationAcceptInfoSuccess {
  success: true;
  organizationName: string;
  organizationSlug?: string;
  domain: string;
  maskedEmail: string;
  accountExists: boolean;
  role: string;
}

export interface InvitationAcceptInfoError {
  success: false;
  error: 'invalid_or_expired';
  status: 400;
  message: string;
}

export type InvitationAcceptInfoResult = InvitationAcceptInfoSuccess | InvitationAcceptInfoError;

/**
 * Returns masked metadata for the unauthenticated invite acceptance screen:
 * - Never reveals full email address (masks local part).
 * - Reveals organization name and domain.
 * - Indicates if account exists in database for this email.
 * - Returns generic invalid_or_expired on invalid or expired token.
 */
export async function getInvitationAcceptInfo(
  rawToken: string
): Promise<InvitationAcceptInfoResult> {
  if (!rawToken || typeof rawToken !== 'string') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  const tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);
  const invite = await invitationRepo.findByTokenHash(tokenHash);

  if (!invite) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  // Check if invitation is expired, revoked, or accepted
  if (
    invite.status === 'revoked' ||
    invite.revoked_at ||
    invite.status === 'accepted' ||
    invite.accepted_at ||
    invite.status === 'declined' ||
    invite.declined_at ||
    new Date(invite.expires_at) <= new Date()
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  const org = await orgRepo.findById(invite.organization_id);
  const existingUser = await userRepo.findByEmail(invite.email);

  // Mask email: e.g. "john.doe@example.com" -> "j***@example.com"
  const atIndex = invite.email.indexOf('@');
  const localPart = atIndex > 0 ? invite.email.slice(0, atIndex) : '';
  const domain = atIndex > 0 ? invite.email.slice(atIndex + 1) : '';
  const firstChar = localPart.length > 0 ? localPart[0] : '';
  const maskedEmail = `${firstChar}***@${domain}`;

  return {
    success: true,
    organizationName: org?.name || 'Innoventix Workspace',
    organizationSlug: org?.slug,
    domain,
    maskedEmail,
    accountExists: !!existingUser,
    role: invite.role,
  };
}

export interface DeclineInvitationSuccess {
  success: true;
  invitation: Invitation;
}

export interface DeclineInvitationError {
  success: false;
  error: 'invalid_or_expired' | 'invalid_status';
  status: number;
  message: string;
}

export type DeclineInvitationResult = DeclineInvitationSuccess | DeclineInvitationError;

/**
 * Declines an invitation by token:
 * - Only pending invitations may be declined.
 * - Sets status=declined and declined_at=now.
 * - Writes invite.declined audit event.
 */
export async function declineInvitation(
  rawToken: string
): Promise<DeclineInvitationResult> {
  if (!rawToken || typeof rawToken !== 'string') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  const tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);
  const invite = await invitationRepo.findByTokenHash(tokenHash);

  if (!invite) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  if (new Date(invite.expires_at) <= new Date() || invite.status === 'expired') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  if (invite.status !== 'pending') {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_status',
      status: 400,
      message: `Cannot decline invitation that is currently ${invite.status}`,
    };
  }

  const updated = await invitationRepo.updateStatus(invite.organization_id, invite.id, {
    status: 'declined',
    declinedAt: new Date(),
  });

  if (!updated) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'invalid_or_expired',
      status: 400,
      message: 'This invitation is invalid or has expired',
    };
  }

  // Audit event
  await logInvitationAudit({
    action: 'invite.declined',
    organizationId: invite.organization_id,
    targetEmail: updated.email,
    role: updated.role,
    details: {
      invitationId: updated.id,
      declinedAt: updated.declined_at,
    },
  });

  return {
    success: true,
    invitation: updated,
  };
}

/**
 * =============================================================================
 * Innoventix Platform v2 — Organization Service
 * =============================================================================
 * Business logic layer for Multi-Tenancy, Team Management, Invitations, and Member Roles.
 */

import crypto from 'crypto';
import { orgRepo } from '../db/repositories/org-repo';
import { userRepo } from '../db/repositories/user-repo';
import { auditRepo } from '../db/repositories/audit-repo';
import { query, queryOne } from '../db';
import { NotFoundError, ForbiddenError, ValidationError, ConflictError } from '../utils/error-handler';
import { Organization, MembershipRole } from '../types/database';

export class OrganizationService {
  /**
   * Get organization by ID
   */
  async getOrganization(orgId: string): Promise<Organization> {
    const org = await orgRepo.findById(orgId);
    if (!org) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Organization not found');
    }
    return org;
  }

  /**
   * Create a new organization and assign owner
   */
  async createOrganization(
    ownerUserId: string,
    data: { name: string; slug: string; logoUrl?: string | null }
  ): Promise<Organization> {
    // Check if slug is taken
    const existing = await orgRepo.findBySlug(data.slug);
    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictError('Organization slug is already in use');
    }

    const { transaction } = await import('../db');
    const { pipelineRepo } = await import('../db/repositories/pipeline-repo');

    // Atomic transaction: org insert + owner membership + default pipeline & stages
    const org = await transaction(async (client) => {
      // 1. Insert organization row
      const insertRes = await client.query<Organization>(
        `INSERT INTO organizations (name, slug, plan_tier, billing_status, logo_url, is_suspended, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, 'free', 'active', $3, false, NOW(), NOW())
         RETURNING *`,
        [data.name.trim(), data.slug.toLowerCase().trim(), data.logoUrl || null]
      );
      const newOrg = insertRes.rows[0];

      // 2. Add owner membership
      await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role)
         VALUES ($1, $2, 'owner')
         ON CONFLICT (organization_id, user_id) DO NOTHING`,
        [newOrg.id, ownerUserId]
      );

      // 3. Seed default sales pipeline & 6 stages inside the SAME transaction
      await pipelineRepo.ensureDefaultPipeline(newOrg.id, ownerUserId, client);

      return newOrg;
    });

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: org.id,
      userId: ownerUserId,
      action: 'ORGANIZATION_CREATED',
      resourceType: 'organization',
      resourceId: org.id,
      metadata: { name: org.name, slug: org.slug },
    });

    return org;
  }

  /**
   * Update organization profile
   */
  async updateOrganization(
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    data: { name?: string; logoUrl?: string | null }
  ): Promise<Organization> {
    const updated = await orgRepo.update(orgId, data);
    if (!updated) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Organization not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'ORGANIZATION_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'organization',
      resourceId: orgId,
      metadata: data,
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Get organization settings
   */
  async getSettings(orgId: string): Promise<Record<string, any>> {
    const row = await queryOne<{ settings: any }>('SELECT settings FROM organizations WHERE id = $1', [orgId]);
    if (!row) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Organization not found');
    }
    return row.settings || {};
  }

  /**
   * Update organization settings (branding, notifications, defaults)
   */
  async updateSettings(orgId: string, actorUserId: string, settings: Record<string, any>): Promise<Record<string, any>> {
    const row = await queryOne<{ settings: any }>(
      'UPDATE organizations SET settings = COALESCE(settings, \'{}\'::jsonb) || $2::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING settings',
      [orgId, JSON.stringify(settings)]
    );
    if (!row) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Organization not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'ORGANIZATION_SETTINGS_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'organization',
      resourceId: orgId,
      metadata: { keys: Object.keys(settings) },
    });

    return row.settings;
  }

  /**
   * Get all members for an organization
   */
  async getMembers(orgId: string) {
    return await orgRepo.getMembers(orgId);
  }

  /**
   * Invite or add a member to the organization
   */
  async addMember(
    orgId: string,
    invitedByUserId: string,
    userEmail: string,
    role: MembershipRole = 'member'
  ) {
    const user = await userRepo.findByEmail(userEmail);
    if (!user) {
      // Create pending invitation record if user does not exist yet
      return await this.createInvitation(orgId, invitedByUserId, userEmail, role);
    }

    const member = await orgRepo.addMember(orgId, user.id, role, invitedByUserId);

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: invitedByUserId,
      action: 'TEAM_MEMBER_ADDED',
      resourceType: 'membership',
      resourceId: member.id,
      metadata: { targetEmail: userEmail, role },
    });

    // Also send in-app notification to invited user
    await auditRepo.createNotification({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: user.id,
      title: 'Joined Organization',
      body: `You have been added to the organization as a ${role}.`,
      type: 'info',
    });

    return member;
  }

  /**
   * Create an email invitation token
   */
  async createInvitation(orgId: string, invitedByUserId: string, email: string, role: MembershipRole = 'member') {
    const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); // 7 days

    await query(
      `INSERT INTO auth_tokens (user_id, email, token_hash, type, expires_at)
       VALUES (NULL, $1, $2, 'magic_link', $3)`,
      [email, tokenHash, expiresAt]
    );



    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: invitedByUserId,
      action: 'TEAM_MEMBER_INVITED',
      resourceType: 'invitation',
      resourceId: email,
      metadata: { email, role, expiresAt },
    });

    return {
      status: 'invited',
      email,
      role,
      token,
      expiresAt,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Get pending invitations for an organization
   */
  async getInvitations(orgId: string) {
    const sql = `
      SELECT id, action, resource_id as email, metadata, created_at
      FROM audit_logs
      WHERE organization_id = $1 AND action = 'TEAM_MEMBER_INVITED'
      ORDER BY created_at DESC
      LIMIT 50
    `;
    const res = await query(sql, [orgId]);
    return res.rows;
  }

  /**
   * Update a member's role (ensures at least 1 owner remains)
   */
  async updateMemberRole(
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    targetUserId: string,
    newRole: MembershipRole
  ) {
    if (newRole !== 'owner') {
      const members = await orgRepo.getMembers(orgId);
      const currentOwners = members.filter((m) => m.role === 'owner');
      if (currentOwners.length === 1 && currentOwners[0].user_id === targetUserId) {
        throw new ValidationError('Cannot demote the sole organization owner. Transfer ownership first.');
      }
    }

    const updated = await orgRepo.updateMemberRole(orgId, targetUserId, newRole);
    if (!updated) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Member record not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'membership',
      resourceId: targetUserId,
      metadata: { newRole },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Remove a member from the organization
   */
  async removeMember(orgId: string, actorUserId: string, targetUserId: string) {
    const members = await orgRepo.getMembers(orgId);
    const target = members.find((m) => m.user_id === targetUserId);
    if (!target) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Member not found in organization');
    }

    if (target.role === 'owner') {
      const owners = members.filter((m) => m.role === 'owner');
      if (owners.length <= 1) {
        throw new ValidationError('Cannot remove the sole organization owner.');
      }
    }

    const removed = await orgRepo.removeMember(orgId, targetUserId);

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'TEAM_MEMBER_REMOVED',
      resourceType: 'membership',
      resourceId: targetUserId,
    });

    return removed;
  }

  /**
   * Delete / suspend an organization
   */
  async deleteOrganization(orgId: string, actorUserId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    await this.getOrganization(orgId);
    await query('UPDATE organizations SET is_suspended = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1', [orgId]);

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'ORGANIZATION_DELETED',
      resourceType: 'organization',
      resourceId: orgId,
    });

    return true;
  }
}

export const orgService = new OrganizationService();

/**
 * =============================================================================
 * Innoventix Platform v2 — Project Management Service
 * =============================================================================
 * Business logic layer for Projects, Tasks, Deliverables, Template Scaffolding,
 * and Project Lifecycle Operations.
 */

import { projectRepo } from '../db/repositories/project-repo';
import { auditRepo } from '../db/repositories/audit-repo';
import { query, queryOne } from '../db';
import { NotFoundError, ValidationError } from '../utils/error-handler';
import { Project, Task, Deliverable, TaskStatus, PaginationOptions } from '../types/database';

export class ProjectService {
  /**
   * Get project by ID scoped to organization
   */
  async getProject(projectId: string, orgId: string): Promise<Project> {
    const project = await projectRepo.findById(projectId, orgId);
    if (!project) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Project not found');
    }
    return project;
  }

  /**
   * Create a new project
   */
  async createProject(
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    data: {
      title: string;
      clientId: string;
      description?: string | null;
      type?: string | null;
      amount?: number | null;
      currency?: string;
      status?: string;
      priority?: string;
      startDate?: Date | string | null;
      deadline?: Date | string | null;
    }
  ): Promise<Project> {
    const project = await projectRepo.create(orgId, data);

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'PROJECT_CREATED',
      resourceType: 'project',
      resourceId: project.id,
      metadata: { title: project.title, clientId: project.client_id },
    });

    return project;
  }

  /**
   * Update project details
   */
  async updateProject(
    projectId: string,
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    data: Partial<Omit<Project, 'id' | 'organization_id' | 'created_at'>>
  ): Promise<Project> {
    await this.getProject(projectId, orgId);
    const updated = await projectRepo.update(projectId, orgId, data);
    if (!updated) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Project not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'PROJECT_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'project',
      resourceId: projectId,
      metadata: data,
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Delete a project
   */
  async deleteProject(projectId: string, orgId: string, actorUserId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, orgId);
    await query('DELETE FROM projects WHERE id = $1 AND organization_id = $2', [projectId, orgId]);

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'PROJECT_DELETED',
      resourceType: 'project',
      resourceId: projectId,
      metadata: { title: project.title },
    });

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * List projects with pagination and filters
   */
  async listProjects(
    orgId: string,
    options?: PaginationOptions & { clientId?: string; status?: string; search?: string }
  ) {
    return await projectRepo.list(orgId, options);
  }

  /**
   * Get tasks for a project
   */
  async getTasks(projectId: string, orgId: string) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, orgId);
    return await projectRepo.getTasks(projectId, orgId);
  }

  /**
   * Create a new task
   */
  async createTask(
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    data: {
      projectId: string;
      title: string;
      description?: string | null;
      priority?: any;
      assignedTo?: string | null;
      dueDate?: Date | string | null;
    }
  ): Promise<Task> {
    await this.getProject(data.projectId, orgId);
    const task = await projectRepo.createTask(orgId, data);

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'TASK_CREATED',
      resourceType: 'task',
      resourceId: task.id,
      metadata: { title: task.title, projectId: task.project_id },
    });

    return task;
  }

  /**
   * Update task status
   */
  async updateTaskStatus(
    taskId: string,
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    status: TaskStatus
  ): Promise<Task> {
    const updated = await projectRepo.updateTask(taskId, orgId, { status });
    if (!updated) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Task not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'TASK_STATUS_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'task',
      resourceId: taskId,
      metadata: { newStatus: status },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Update full task details
   */
  async updateTask(
    taskId: string,
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    data: Partial<Omit<Task, 'id' | 'organization_id' | 'created_at'>>
  ): Promise<Task> {
    const updated = await projectRepo.updateTask(taskId, orgId, data);
    if (!updated) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Task not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'TASK_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'task',
      resourceId: taskId,
      metadata: data,
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Delete a task
   */
  async deleteTask(taskId: string, orgId: string, actorUserId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await query('DELETE FROM tasks WHERE id = $1 AND organization_id = $2', [taskId, orgId]);
    if ((res.rowCount ?? 0) === 0) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Task not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'TASK_DELETED',
      resourceType: 'task',
      resourceId: taskId,
    });

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Get deliverables for a project
   */
  async getDeliverables(projectId: string, orgId: string) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, orgId);
    return await projectRepo.getDeliverables(projectId, orgId);
  }

  /**
   * Create a deliverable for a project
   */
  async createDeliverable(
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    data: {
      projectId: string;
      title: string;
      fileUrl?: string | null;
      driveLink?: string | null;
    }
  ): Promise<Deliverable> {
    await this.getProject(data.projectId, orgId);
    const deliverable = await projectRepo.createDeliverable(orgId, data);

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'DELIVERABLE_CREATED',
      resourceType: 'deliverable',
      resourceId: deliverable.id,
      metadata: { title: deliverable.title, projectId: deliverable.project_id },
    });

    return deliverable;
  }

  /**
   * Update or review deliverable status (e.g. approved / rejected)
   */
  async updateDeliverable(
    deliverableId: string,
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    data: { status?: 'pending' | 'in_review' | 'approved' | 'rejected'; feedback?: string }
  ) {
    const res = await query(
      `UPDATE deliverables 
       SET status = COALESCE($1, status), 
           feedback = COALESCE($2, feedback), 
           updated_at = NOW() 
       WHERE id = $3 AND organization_id = $4 
       RETURNING *`,
      [data.status, data.feedback, deliverableId, orgId]
    );

    const deliverable = res.rows[0];
    if (!deliverable) {
      throw new NotFoundError('Deliverable not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'DELIVERABLE_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'deliverable',
      resourceId: deliverableId,
      metadata: data,
    });

    return deliverable;
  }

  /**
   * List all project templates
   */
  async listTemplates(orgId: string) {
    const res = await query(
      'SELECT * FROM project_templates WHERE organization_id = $1 OR is_public = true ORDER BY name ASC',
      [orgId]
    );
    return res.rows;
  }

  /**
   * Create a new project template
   */
  async createTemplate(
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    data: {
      name: string;
      description?: string;
      category?: string;
      isPublic?: boolean;
    }
  ) {
    const res = await query(
      `INSERT INTO project_templates (organization_id, name, description, category, is_public)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
       RETURNING *`,
      [orgId, data.name, data.description || null, data.category || 'General', data.isPublic ?? false]
    );
    const template = res.rows[0];

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'PROJECT_TEMPLATE_CREATED',
      resourceType: 'project_template',
      resourceId: template.id,
      metadata: { name: template.name },
    });

    return template;
  }

  /**
   * Instantiate project from template
   */
  async createFromTemplate(
    orgId: string,
    actorUserId: string,
    templateId: string,
    clientId: string,
    projectName: string,
    startDate?: Date
  ): Promise<Project> {
    const project = await projectRepo.createFromTemplate(
      orgId,
      templateId,
      clientId,
      projectName,
      startDate
    );

    await auditRepo.log({
      organizationId: orgId,
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'PROJECT_CREATED_FROM_TEMPLATE',
      resourceType: 'project',
      resourceId: project.id,
      metadata: { templateId, projectName },
    });

    return project;
  }
}

/**
 * =============================================================================
 * Innoventix Platform v2 — User Service
 * =============================================================================
 * Business logic layer for User Management, Profile updates, Preferences, and Security.
 */

import { userRepo } from '../db/repositories/user-repo';
import { auditRepo } from '../db/repositories/audit-repo';
import { query, queryOne } from '../db';
import { hashPassword } from '../auth/password';
import { NotFoundError, ValidationError, ConflictError } from '../utils/error-handler';
import { User, PaginationOptions } from '../types/database';

export class UserService {
  /**
   * Get user profile by ID
   */
  async getUserProfile(userId: string): Promise<User> {
    const user = await userRepo.findById(userId);
    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundError('User not found');
    }
    return user;
  }

  /**
   * Update user profile details
   */
  async updateProfile(
    userId: string,
    data: {
      fullName?: string | null;
      avatarUrl?: string | null;
    }
  ): Promise<User> {
    const updated = await userRepo.update(userId, data);
    if (!updated) {
      throw new NotFoundError('User not found or inactive');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      userId,
      action: 'USER_PROFILE_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'user',
      resourceId: userId,
      metadata: { fields: Object.keys(data) },
    });

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Get user preferences (UI theme, notifications, defaults)
   */
  async getUserPreferences(userId: string): Promise<Record<string, any>> {
    const row = await queryOne<{ preferences: any }>('SELECT preferences FROM users WHERE id = $1', [userId]);
    if (!row) {
      throw new NotFoundError('User not found');
    }
    return row.preferences || {};
  }

  /**
   * Update user preferences
   */
  async updateUserPreferences(userId: string, preferences: Record<string, any>): Promise<Record<string, any>> {
    const row = await queryOne<{ preferences: any }>(
      'UPDATE users SET preferences = COALESCE(preferences, \'{}\'::jsonb) || $2::jsonb, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING preferences',
      [userId, JSON.stringify(preferences)]
    );
    if (!row) {
      throw new NotFoundError('User not found');
    }

    await auditRepo.log({
      userId,
      action: 'USER_PREFERENCES_UPDATED',
      resourceType: 'user',
      resourceId: userId,
      metadata: { keys: Object.keys(preferences) },
    });

    return row.preferences;
  }

  /**
   * Admin: Create a new user directly
   */
  async adminCreateUser(data: {
    email: string;
    password: string;
    fullName?: string;
    role?: 'user' | 'org_admin' | 'super_admin';
  }): Promise<User> {
    const existing = await userRepo.findByEmail(data.email);
    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictError('A user with this email already exists');
    }

    const passwordHash = await hashPassword(data.password);
    const user = await userRepo.create({
      email: data.email,
      passwordHash,
      fullName: data.fullName,
      role: data.role || 'user',
    });

    return user;
  }

  /**
   * Admin: Deactivate a user
   */
  async deactivateUser(userId: string, actorUserId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const user = await this.getUserProfile(userId);
    const deactivated = await userRepo.deactivate(userId);

    await auditRepo.log({
      userId: actorUserId,
      action: 'USER_DEACTIVATED',
      resourceType: 'user',
      resourceId: userId,
      metadata: { email: user.email },
    });

    return deactivated;
  }

  /**
   * Get all organizations the user belongs to
   */
  async getUserOrganizations(userId: string) {
    return await userRepo.getMemberships(userId);
  }

  /**
   * List users with pagination (Admin access)
   */
  async listUsers(pagination?: PaginationOptions & { search?: string }) {
    if (pagination?.search) {
      const search = `%${pagination.search}%`;
      const page = pagination.page || 1;
      const limit = pagination.limit || 20;
      const offset = (page - 1) * limit;

      const [usersRes, countRes] = await Promise.all([
        query<User>(
          'SELECT * FROM users WHERE is_active = true AND (email ILIKE $1 OR full_name ILIKE $1) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3',
          [search, limit, offset]
        ),
        queryOne<{ count: string }>(
          'SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM users WHERE is_active = true AND (email ILIKE $1 OR full_name ILIKE $1)',
          [search]
        ),
      ]);

      return {
        users: usersRes.rows,
        total: parseInt(countRes?.count || '0', 10),
      };
    }

    return await userRepo.list(pagination);
  }

  /**
   * Super Admin: Impersonate a user or support access for an organization
   */
  async impersonateUser(
    targetUserId: string,
    superAdminUserId: string,
    orgId?: string
  ): Promise<{ targetUser: User; impersonatorId: string; expiresAt: Date }> {
    const targetUser = await this.getUserProfile(targetUserId);
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000); // 1 hour session

    await auditRepo.log({
      userId: superAdminUserId,
      actorIsSuperAdmin: true,
      organizationId: orgId || null,
      action: 'SUPER_ADMIN_IMPERSONATION_START',
      resourceType: 'user',
      resourceId: targetUserId,
      metadata: { targetEmail: targetUser.email, expiresAt: expiresAt.toISOString() },
    });

    return {
      targetUser,
      impersonatorId: superAdminUserId,
      expiresAt,
    };
  }
}

export const userService = new UserService();

/**
 * Innoventix Platform — Stripe Configuration & Validation (Prompt 45)
 * 
 * Rules:
 * - Read only: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID.
 * - sk_live_ outside production throws error and refuses to start.
 * - sk_test_ in production logs a warning that test mode is active.
 * - Never log keys or leak secrets to the client.
 */

export interface StripeConfig {
  secretKey: string
  publishableKey: string
  webhookSecret: string
  proPriceId: string
  isTestMode: boolean
}

export function validateStripeConfig(): StripeConfig {
  const secretKey = (process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY || '').trim()
  const publishableKey = (process.env.STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY || '').trim()
  const webhookSecret = (process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET || '').trim()
  const proPriceId = (process.env.STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID || '').trim()
  const isProd = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'

  // Safety rule: Never allow sk_live_ outside production
  if (secretKey.startsWith('sk_live_') && !isProd) {
    throw new Error(
      'Security Exception: sk_live_ secret key cannot be used outside of production environment.'
    )
  }

  // Safety rule: Warn if test keys are used in live production
  if (secretKey.startsWith('sk_test_') && isProd) {
    console.warn(
      '[STRIPE_CONFIG_WARNING] Stripe test mode key (sk_test_*) is currently active on the live site.'
    )
  }

  return {
    secretKey,
    publishableKey,
    webhookSecret,
    proPriceId,
    isTestMode: secretKey.startsWith('sk_test_'),
  }
}

export function getStripePublishableKey(): string {
  return (process.env.STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY || '').trim()
}

import { query, queryOne } from '@/lib/db'

import { logAuditEvent } from '@/lib/audit/logger'
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'

}

export interface RemoveMemberInput {
  memberId: string
}

/**
 * Server Action: Update Organization Profile
 * Restricted to 'owner' or 'admin' roles.
 */
export async function updateOrganizationProfile(input: UpdateOrgProfileInput) {
  const session = await getCurrentSessionContext()

  if (!session || !session.user || !session.organization) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active session.' }
  }

  // Confirm target organization matches user active organization
  if (session.organization.id !== input.organizationId) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Organization mismatch.' }
  }

  // Server-side Role Check
  if (session.role !== 'owner' && session.role !== 'admin' && !session.isSuperAdmin) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Only owners and admins can edit organization profile.' }
  }

  try {
    await query(
      `UPDATE organizations
       SET name = $1,
           industry_type = $2,
           logo_url = $3,
           timezone = $4,
           updated_at = NOW()
       WHERE id = $5`,
      [
        input.name,
        input.industryType,
        input.logoUrl || null,
        input.timezone || 'UTC',
        input.organizationId,
      ]
    )

    await logAuditEvent({
      actorId: session.user.id,
      action: 'ORGANIZATION_PROFILE_UPDATE',
      targetType: 'organization',
      targetId: input.organizationId,
      details: {
        name: input.name,
        industryType: input.industryType,
        logoUrl: input.logoUrl,
        timezone: input.timezone,
      },
    })

    revalidatePath('/settings/organization')
    revalidatePath('/dashboard')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Error updating organization profile:', error)
    return { success: false, error: error.message || 'Update failed' }
  }
}

/**
 * Server Action: Invite Team Member
 * Restricted to 'owner' or 'admin' roles.
 */
export async function inviteTeamMember(input: InviteMemberInput) {
  const session = await getCurrentSessionContext()

  if (!session || !session.user || !session.organization) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active session.' }
  }

  // Server-side Role Check
  if (session.role !== 'owner' && session.role !== 'admin' && !session.isSuperAdmin) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Only owners and admins can invite team members.' }
  }

  const cleanEmail = input.email.trim().toLowerCase()
  if (!cleanEmail) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Valid email address is required.' }
  }

  try {
    // 1. Check if user already exists with this email
    const existingUser = await queryOne<{ id: string; email: string }>(
      'SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email = $1',
      [cleanEmail]
    )

    if (existingUser) {
      // Check if user is already a member of this organization
      const existingMember = await queryOne<{ id: string }>(
        'SELECT id FROM organization_members WHERE organization_id = $1 AND user_id = $2',
        [session.organization.id, existingUser.id]
      )

      if (existingMember) {
        return { success: false, error: 'This user is already a member of your organization.' }
      }

      // Add existing user as an org member
      await query(
        `INSERT INTO organization_members (organization_id, user_id, role, invited_by)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)`,
        [session.organization.id, existingUser.id, input.role, session.user.id]
      )
    } else {
      console.log(`[TEAM_INVITE_STUB] Invitation dispatched to ${cleanEmail} for role ${input.role} in org ${session.organization.name}`)
    }

    await logAuditEvent({
      actorId: session.user.id,
      action: 'TEAM_MEMBER_INVITED',
      targetType: 'organization_member',
      targetId: session.organization.id,
      details: { email: cleanEmail, role: input.role },
    })

    revalidatePath('/settings/team')
    return {
      success: true,
      message: existingUser ? 'Member added successfully!' : `Invitation email stubbed for ${cleanEmail}`,
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error inviting team member:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Invitation failed' }
  }
}

/**
 * Server Action: Update Member Role (Prompt 36)
 * Rules:
 * - Owner can change any role except their own.
 * - Admin can change member and viewer roles only, and cannot touch owner or admin.
 * - Admin cannot promote a member to admin or owner.
 * - Demoting the last owner is forbidden.
 * - Sends email notification and records audit event.
 */
export async function updateMemberRole(input: UpdateRoleInput) {
  const session = await getCurrentSessionContext()

  if (!session || !session.user || !session.organization) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active session.' }
  }

  const isOwner = session.role === 'owner' || session.isSuperAdmin
  const isAdmin = session.role === 'admin'

  if (!isOwner && !isAdmin) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Only owners and admins can update member roles.' }
  }

  try {
    // Fetch the target member record
    const targetMember = await queryOne<{ id: string; organization_id: string; user_id: string; role: string }>(
      'SELECT id, organization_id, user_id, role FROM organization_members WHERE id = $1 AND organization_id = $2',
      [input.memberId, session.organization.id]
    )

    if (!targetMember) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Target member record not found.' }
    }

    // Rule: Owner cannot change their own role
    if (targetMember.user_id === session.user.id) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Cannot change your own role.' }
    }

    // Rule: Admin can change member and viewer roles only, and cannot touch owner or admin
    if (isAdmin) {
      if (targetMember.role === 'owner' || targetMember.role === 'admin') {
        return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Admins cannot change owner or admin roles.' }
      }
      if (input.newRole === 'owner' || input.newRole === 'admin') {
        return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Admins cannot promote members to admin or owner.' }
      }
    }

    // Prevent demoting the last owner of the organization
    if (targetMember.role === 'owner' && input.newRole !== 'owner') {
      const ownerCountRes = await queryOne<{ count: string }>(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM organization_members WHERE organization_id = $1 AND role = 'owner'",
        [session.organization.id]
      )
      const ownerCount = parseInt(ownerCountRes?.count || '0', 10)

      if (ownerCount <= 1) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Cannot demote the last owner of an organization.' }
      }
    }

    // Update member role
    await query(
      `UPDATE organization_members
       SET role = $1, updated_at = NOW()
       WHERE id = $2 AND organization_id = $3`,
      [input.newRole, input.memberId, session.organization.id]
    )

    // Audit log
    await logAuditEvent({
      actorId: session.user.id,
      action: 'TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE_UPDATED',
      targetType: 'organization_member',
      targetId: input.memberId,
      details: { oldRole: targetMember.role, newRole: input.newRole },
    })

    // Transactional email notification to the member (Prompt 30 & 36)
    try {
      const targetUser = await queryOne<{ email: string; full_name?: string }>(
        'SELECT email, full_name FROM users WHERE id = $1',
        [targetMember.user_id]
      )

      if (targetUser?.email) {
        const emailTemplate = renderRoleChangedEmail({
          organizationName: session.organization.name,
          newRole: input.newRole,
          memberName: targetUser.full_name || undefined,
        })
        await sendEmail({
          to: targetUser.email,
          subject: emailTemplate.subject,
          html: emailTemplate.html,
          text: emailTemplate.text,
        })
      }
    } catch (emailErr) {
      console.warn('Role change email dispatch notice:', emailErr)
    }

    revalidatePath('/settings/team')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error updating member role:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Role update failed' }
  }
}

/**
 * Server Action: Remove Member (Prompt 36)
 * Rules:
 * - Owner and admin can remove members, with confirm.
 * - Cannot remove the owner.
 * - Admin cannot remove owner or admin.
 * - Writes audit events.
 */
export async function removeMember(input: RemoveMemberInput) {
  const session = await getCurrentSessionContext()

  if (!session || !session.user || !session.organization) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: No active session.' }
  }

  const isOwner = session.role === 'owner' || session.isSuperAdmin
  const isAdmin = session.role === 'admin'

  if (!isOwner && !isAdmin) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Only owners and admins can remove team members.' }
  }

  try {
    // Fetch the target member record
    const targetMember = await queryOne<{ id: string; organization_id: string; user_id: string; role: string }>(
      'SELECT id, organization_id, user_id, role FROM organization_members WHERE id = $1 AND organization_id = $2',
      [input.memberId, session.organization.id]
    )

    if (!targetMember) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Target member record not found.' }
    }

    // Rule: Cannot remove the owner
    if (targetMember.role === 'owner') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Cannot remove the organization owner.' }
    }

    // Rule: Admin cannot remove other admins
    if (isAdmin && targetMember.role === 'admin') {
      return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Admins cannot remove other admins.' }
    }

    // Delete member record (seat count drops automatically)
    await query(
      'DELETE FROM organization_members WHERE id = $1 AND organization_id = $2',
      [input.memberId, session.organization.id]
    )

    await logAuditEvent({
      actorId: session.user.id,
      action: 'TEAM_MEMBER_REMOVED',
      targetType: 'organization_member',
      targetId: input.memberId,
      details: { removedUserId: targetMember.user_id, role: targetMember.role },
    })

    revalidatePath('/settings/team')
    return { success: true }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('Error removing org member:', err)
    return { success: false, error: err.message || 'Remove member failed' }
  }
}

/**
 * =============================================================================
 * Innoventix Platform v2 — Application Error Hierarchy
 * =============================================================================
 */

export class AppError extends Error {
  public readonly statusCode: number;
  public readonly code: string;
  public readonly details?: any;

  constructor(message: string, statusCode: number = 500, code: string = 'INTERNAL_ERROR', details?: any) {
    super(message);
    this.name = this.constructor.name;
    this.statusCode = statusCode;
    this.code = code;
    this.details = details;
    Error.captureStackTrace(this, this.constructor);
  }
}

export class NotFoundError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Resource not found', details?: any) {
    super(message, 404, 'NOT_FOUND', details);
  }
}

export class UnauthorizedError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Authentication required', details?: any) {
    super(message, 401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', details);
  }
}

export class ForbiddenError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Insufficient permissions', details?: any) {
    super(message, 403, 'FORBIDDEN', details);
  }
}

export class ValidationError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Validation failed', details?: any) {
    super(message, 400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', details);
  }
}

export class BadRequestError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Bad request', details?: any) {
    super(message, 400, 'BAD_REQUEST', details);
  }
}

export class RateLimitError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Too many requests', details?: any) {
    super(message, 429, 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', details);
  }
}

export class ConflictError extends AppError {
  constructor(message: string = 'Resource already exists or state conflict', details?: any) {
    super(message, 409, 'CONFLICT', details);
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { AppError } from './error-handler';

export interface ApiResponse<T = any> {
  success: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: {
    message: string;
    code: string;
    details?: any;
  };
  meta?: Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * Return a successful JSON API response
 */
export function apiSuccess<T>(data: T, status: number = 200, meta?: Record<string, any>): NextResponse<ApiResponse<T>> {
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      success: true,
      data,
      meta,
    },
    { status }
  );
}

/**
 * Return a paginated JSON API response
 */
export function apiPaginated<T>(
  data: T[],
  total: number,
  page: number,
  limit: number,
  status: number = 200
): NextResponse<ApiResponse<T[]>> {
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / (limit || 1));
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      success: true,
      data,
      meta: {
        total,
        page,
        limit,
        totalPages,
        hasMore: page < totalPages,
      },
    },
    { status }
  );
}

/**
 * Return an error JSON API response
 */
export function apiError(
  message: string,
  status: number = 500,
  code: string = 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
  details?: any
): NextResponse<ApiResponse<null>> {
  return NextResponse.json(
    {
      success: false,
      error: {
        message,
        code,
        details,
      },
    },
    { status }
  );
}

/**
 * Extract standard pagination parameters from URL search params
 */
export function extractPagination(searchParams: URLSearchParams): {
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  offset: number;
  orderBy?: string;
  orderDirection?: 'ASC' | 'DESC';
} {
  const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(searchParams.get('page') || '1', 10));
  const limit = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, parseInt(searchParams.get('limit') || '20', 10)));
  const offset = (page - 1) * limit;
  const orderBy = searchParams.get('orderBy') || searchParams.get('sortBy') || undefined;
  const orderDirection = searchParams.get('orderDirection')?.toUpperCase() === 'ASC' ? 'ASC' : 'DESC';

  return { page, limit, offset, orderBy, orderDirection };
}

/**
 * Centralized API error catcher
 */
export function handleApiError(error: any): NextResponse<ApiResponse<null>> {
  if (error instanceof AppError) {
    return apiError(error.message, error.statusCode, error.code, error.details);
  }

  console.error('[Unhandled API Error]:', error);
  return apiError(
    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' ? 'Internal server error' : error.message || 'Unknown error occurred',
    500,
    'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR'
  );
}

import { z, ZodError } from 'zod'
import { sanitizeObject } from './sanitize'

export type ValidationResult<T> =
  | { success: true; data: T }
  | { success: false; error: string; fieldErrors?: Record<string, string[]> }

/**
 * Validates and sanitizes raw input against a Zod schema.
 * Rejects invalid payloads with clean user-friendly messages without leaking internal system details.
 */
export function validateAndSanitize<T>(
  schema: z.ZodSchema<T>,
  rawInput: unknown
): ValidationResult<T> {
  try {
    // 1. Pre-sanitize strings in input to neutralize potential injection payloads
    const sanitizedInput = sanitizeObject(rawInput)

    // 2. Parse against schema
    const parsed = schema.parse(sanitizedInput)

    return {
      success: true,
      data: parsed,
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    if (err instanceof ZodError) {
      const fieldErrors: Record<string, string[]> = {}
      const firstError = err.issues[0]?.message || 'Invalid input parameters.'

      err.issues.forEach((issue) => {
        const path = issue.path.join('.') || 'general'
        if (!fieldErrors[path]) {
          fieldErrors[path] = []
        }
        fieldErrors[path].push(issue.message)
      })

      return {
        success: false,
        error: firstError,
        fieldErrors,
      }
    }

    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Malformed or invalid input data.',
    }
  }
}

import { normalizeEmail } from './email';

/**
 * Common consumer and personal webmail domains.
 * Maintained in this single configuration list for straightforward extensibility.
 */
export const PERSONAL_EMAIL_DOMAINS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([
  'gmail.com',
  'googlemail.com',
  'yahoo.com',
  'ymail.com',
  'rocketmail.com',
  'outlook.com',
  'hotmail.com',
  'live.com',
  'msn.com',
  'icloud.com',
  'me.com',
  'mac.com',
  'proton.me',
  'protonmail.com',
  'aol.com',
  'zoho.com',
  'mail.com',
  'gmx.com',
  'gmx.net',
  'yandex.com',
  'yandex.ru',
  'fastmail.com',
  'tutanota.com',
  'tutamail.com',
]);

const personalDomainsSet = new Set(PERSONAL_EMAIL_DOMAINS);

/**
 * Result of email domain classification.
 */
export interface EmailClassification {
  domain: string;
  isPersonal: boolean;
  isBusinessCandidate: boolean;
}

/**
 * Checks whether a given domain (or any parent domain) is in the personal email domains list.
 * Handles subdomains such as `mail.gmail.com` -> `gmail.com`.
 *
 * @param domain Normalized domain string
 * @returns boolean
 */
export function isPersonalEmailDomain(domain: string): boolean {
  if (!domain || typeof domain !== 'string') {
    return false;
  }

  const cleanDomain = domain.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (personalDomainsSet.has(cleanDomain)) {
    return true;
  }

  // Check if it's a subdomain of any known personal provider
  for (const personalDomain of PERSONAL_EMAIL_DOMAINS) {
    if (cleanDomain.endsWith(`.${personalDomain}`)) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Classifies an email address into personal vs business candidate without blocking.
 * Used to:
 * 1. Surface friendly notices when personal addresses are invited to professional workspaces.
 * 2. Assist in determining verified business domain badge status.
 *
 * @param email Raw email candidate
 * @returns EmailClassification result
 */
export function classifyEmail(email: string): EmailClassification {
  if (!email || typeof email !== 'string') {
    return {
      domain: '',
      isPersonal: false,
      isBusinessCandidate: false,
    };
  }

  const normalized = normalizeEmail(email);
  const atIndex = normalized.lastIndexOf('@');

  if (atIndex === -1 || atIndex === normalized.length - 1) {
    return {
      domain: '',
      isPersonal: false,
      isBusinessCandidate: false,
    };
  }

  const domain = normalized.slice(atIndex + 1);
  if (!domain || !domain.includes('.')) {
    return {
      domain: '',
      isPersonal: false,
      isBusinessCandidate: false,
    };
  }

  const isPersonal = isPersonalEmailDomain(domain);

  return {
    domain,
    isPersonal,
    isBusinessCandidate: !isPersonal,
  };
}

/**
 * Email normalization and validation utilities for multi-tenant invitation & auth pipelines.
 * Enforces RFC 5321 length limits, robust formatting rules, and strict control character filtering.
 */

/**
 * Trims leading/trailing whitespace, strips surrounding single or double quotes,
 * and converts the email address to lowercase.
 *
 * @param input Raw email string
 * @returns Normalized email string (lowercase, trimmed, unquoted)
 */
export function normalizeEmail(input: string): string {
  if (typeof input !== 'string') {
    return '';
  }

  let trimmed = input.trim();

  // Strip surrounding quotes if present (double or single quotes)
  if (
    (trimmed.startsWith('"') && trimmed.endsWith('"')) ||
    (trimmed.startsWith("'") && trimmed.endsWith("'"))
  ) {
    trimmed = trimmed.slice(1, -1).trim();
  }

  return trimmed.toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * Validates an email address against practical, robust RFC criteria:
 * - Total length between 1 and 254 characters (RFC 5321)
 * - Exactly one '@' character separating local-part and domain
 * - No whitespace characters
 * - No ASCII control characters (0x00-0x1F, 0x7F) or Unicode control/formatting characters
 * - Local-part is non-empty, max 64 characters, without leading/trailing/consecutive dots
 * - Domain is non-empty, contains at least one dot, without leading/trailing/consecutive dots
 * - Each domain label contains valid hostname characters (alphanumeric and hyphens)
 *
 * @param email Email candidate to validate
 * @returns boolean indicating validity
 */
export function isValidEmail(email: string): boolean {
  if (typeof email !== 'string') {
    return false;
  }

  // Practical check: max length 254 characters (RFC 5321)
  if (!email || email.length > 254) {
    return false;
  }

  // Reject whitespace
  if (/\s/.test(email)) {
    return false;
  }

  // Reject ASCII control characters (0x00-0x1F, 0x7F-0x9F) and Unicode control / invisible format characters
  for (let i = 0; i < email.length; i++) {
    const code = email.charCodeAt(i);
    if (code <= 0x1f || (code >= 0x7f && code <= 0x9f)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Unicode control and formatting characters (\p{C})
  try {
    const unicodeControlRegex = new RegExp('\\p{C}', 'u');
    if (unicodeControlRegex.test(email)) {
      return false;
    }
  } catch {
    // Environment fallback
  }

  // Must contain exactly one '@'
  const atIndex = email.indexOf('@');
  if (atIndex === -1 || atIndex !== email.lastIndexOf('@')) {
    return false;
  }

  const localPart = email.slice(0, atIndex);
  const domainPart = email.slice(atIndex + 1);

  if (!localPart || !domainPart) {
    return false;
  }

  // Local part max length check (RFC 5321 max 64)
  if (localPart.length > 64) {
    return false;
  }

  // Local part cannot start or end with a dot, or have consecutive dots
  if (localPart.startsWith('.') || localPart.endsWith('.') || localPart.includes('..')) {
    return false;
  }

  // Domain cannot start or end with a dot, or have consecutive dots
  if (domainPart.startsWith('.') || domainPart.endsWith('.') || domainPart.includes('..')) {
    return false;
  }

  // Domain must contain at least one dot
  const domainLabels = domainPart.split('.');
  if (domainLabels.length < 2) {
    return false;
  }

  // Each domain label must be non-empty and a valid hostname label (letters, digits, hyphens, not start/end with hyphen)
  const domainLabelRegex = /^[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?$/;
  for (const label of domainLabels) {
    if (!label || label.length > 63 || !domainLabelRegex.test(label)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Standard local part character sanity check
  const localPartRegex = /^[a-zA-Z0-9!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~.-]+$/;
  if (!localPartRegex.test(localPart)) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}
